tagline: Your own online store, with an AI shop assistant.

steps.text: ShopFlow: your own online store, with an AI shop assistant. Here's one order, start to finish.
steps.say: Shop Flow. Your own online store, with an AI shop assistant. Here's one order, start to finish.

steps.title: Ask the AI shop assistant
steps.text: Customers ask the AI shop assistant. It checks your real stock and prepares the cart.

steps.title: Check out & pay
steps.text: They check out, then pay by GCash or bank transfer, or cash on delivery.
steps.say: They check out, then pay by G Cash or bank transfer, or cash on delivery.

steps.title: Upload the payment screenshot
steps.text: Then they upload the payment screenshot.

steps.title: Check the payment
steps.text: You compare it, and tap Payment received.

steps.title: Your AI store co-pilot
steps.text: Your co-pilot prepares changes like "mark as packed". Nothing happens until you tap Confirm.
steps.say: Your co-pilot prepares changes, like, mark as packed. Nothing happens until you tap, Confirm.

steps.title: Ship & track
steps.text: Add the tracking number, and your customer follows every step.
